_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 21: 2025-08-30 to 2025-09-07, including the Glimpse Into 2026 video. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He rests the whole window on 2 Chronicles 7:14, that if the body humbles itself and prays and turns from wicked ways God will hear and heal the land, and points back to the October prayer as Americans.
mentions.quote: as we prayed in October as Americans and we prayed as the body
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the healing of the land is asserted rather than observed.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the prayer conference where everyone interceded for change, asks what will be done with it, and reports the Lord saying not to become complacent in this season of victory.
mentions.quote: do not become so complacent with this season of vict
mentions.condition_text: the window holds only if they keep their foot on the gas
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the complacency clause explains any loss of the window.

mentions.claim_text: He calls prayer for good leaders in positions of authority going into 2027 and 2028, because that is the time frame in which he saw a major shaking still coming, heading into the next shmita cycle.
mentions.quote: this is the time frame that I saw a major shaking still coming
mentions.falsify_match: A major national shaking in 2027 or 2028.

mentions.claim_text: In discussion he puts the next shmita boundary at 2032, allows he could be wrong, and works out that it would then be seven years after that.
mentions.quote: I think it's 2032. Okay. I believe I could be wrong
mentions.falsify_match: A third date for the same boundary, after 2028 and 2029. He flags the uncertainty himself.

mentions.claim_text: He says always speaking victory can do a disservice, and that people need to know how to believe God through the valley and speak to the mountain when the storms come.
mentions.quote: You need to know how to believe God through your valley
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching, and a rare qualification of the declare-it-and-have-it material.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying it will be like nothing they have ever seen before and that it is time to expect to witness something unprecedented, noting people are not always sure whether manifestations are real.
mentions.quote: it will be like we've ne you've never seen it before
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord says people are no longer coming in with fishing poles but by the net, and that there will be a moment when everything changes in a twenty four hour period just as it did with 9/11.
mentions.quote: They're coming in by the net fools
mentions.falsify_match: A mass conversion event alongside a single transformative day.

mentions.claim_text: He says those who do not build themselves up will be spiritual wimps, and that when the devourer knocks on the door he will come in and eat.
mentions.quote: you're going to be spiritual wimp
mentions.condition_text: protection conditioned on being built up
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching with a condition that assigns any loss to the hearer.

mentions.claim_text: He reads Romans 8:18 and 2 Corinthians 4:17 on present sufferings not being worth comparing with the glory to be revealed.
mentions.quote: the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: scripture read straight.

mentions.claim_text: He opens saying they have a word from the Lord about 2026 and the rest of 2025, given while praying for Trump the day before.
mentions.quote: we have a word from the Lord um that is very uh uh about 2026
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing. This is the video he later points back to as the glimpse into 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord caught him off guard, telling him he wanted to show him more that is coming and the decisions concerning Trump that need to be prayed over.
mentions.quote: show you more that's coming and the decisions that need to be prayed over
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: Against people asking about a September rapture, he says what comes in September is a time to remember, that everything known will change in a twenty four hour period, like water going over the dam.
mentions.quote: in September is a time to remember for it will be in a 24-hour period
mentions.falsify_match: A single day in September 2025 on which everything changes.

mentions.claim_text: He says what he saw makes the BLM rioting of 2020 in the big cities look like nothing, and that it is across the world.
mentions.quote: nothing compared to that is nothing to what I saw. It is across the world
mentions.falsify_match: Worldwide rioting exceeding the 2020 unrest in scale.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Trump finishing with a pep in his step as he blesses Israel, with a blessing on him, then going into the fall with things changing, and reaching January with a book like a scroll.
mentions.quote: he was finishing it as he blessed Israel. There was a blessing on him
mentions.falsify_match: Trump signing something of founding weight in January 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Trump writing new legislation concerning America and digital platforms for money, then oil derricks pumping and drill baby drill again.
mentions.quote: new legislation on this concerning the United States of America and a digital platforms
mentions.falsify_match: US digital currency legislation alongside a drilling expansion.

mentions.claim_text: He says to line your pockets in this season, describing gold on the soil that people scooped up as fast as they could though it was not thick enough to build a foundation on, with Trump parading a pig.
mentions.quote: So line your pockets in this season
mentions.falsify_match: A short window of gains that proves too thin to last.
mentions.falsify_miss: The gains prove durable, or never come.

mentions.claim_text: He reports hearing that a stalemate presidency will run for the rest of the term, that Trump must act quickly on whatever laws he wants passed, and that the stalemate covers 2027 and 2028.
mentions.quote: a stalemate presidency will be at the second term
mentions.falsify_match: Legislative deadlock across 2027 and 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: The administration continues to pass its agenda.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that this is not financial advice but a vision and a warning of what he feels the Lord has told him, and answers those who disagree.
mentions.quote: it's not financial advice. This is just a vision
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: disclaimer. Word for word the same block as WCSr1gn7mlM@4834 three weeks later.

mentions.claim_text: He describes explosions with glass flying everywhere and being able to feel the atmosphere, and says the Lord showed him British Columbia again with a major earthquake.
mentions.quote: I saw a major earthquake agai
mentions.falsify_match: A major earthquake in British Columbia.

mentions.claim_text: He works out that the rapture either takes place in 2028 at the beginning of the shmita cycle to start Jacob's trouble and a seven year tribulation with a three and a half year great tribulation in the middle, or it starts seven years after that cycle.
mentions.quote: a rapture of the church either would take place in 2028
mentions.falsify_match: The rapture at one of the two dates he offers.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither, though offering both makes it hard to miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says the enemy would have Trump die as a president, not by someone hurting him but through bad choices in the past under great demonic pressure, and recalls calling him the log in the road.
mentions.quote: the enemy would have him try to die as a as a president
mentions.falsify_match: Trump dying in office of health causes.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying I am giving you a three year window to pray and to have a major harvest of souls, a three year window to get the job done, and asks what they will do with it.
mentions.quote: I'm giving you a three-year window. three this three-year window to pray
mentions.falsify_match: A harvest inside three years from August 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note this is three years where every earlier telling said four.

mentions.claim_text: He says if the devil cannot get you through sexual misconduct he will get you through stress and your health, calls him a slimy slithering snake, and says the body of Christ must uplift and pray for him.
mentions.quote: he'll get you through uh stress and and and your health
mentions.falsify_match: A health crisis for the president.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw into September that the major decisions will be made in December, a make or break time for the United States, and that the month they step into in the next forty eight hours is vital and they must line up and pray for Israel.
mentions.quote: the major decisions that will be made will be made in December
mentions.falsify_match: Decisions of make or break weight for America taken in December 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing a line dividing each year when he goes up prophetically, being able to look into each year and pinpoint 2026 or 2027, and telling people to write it down.
mentions.quote: I see a line dividing each year when I go up prophetically
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as framing, and it is the clearest account of how he assigns years to what he sees.

mentions.claim_text: He says birthing pains accelerate as they step into September, that the Lord showed a new beginning and a starting line with a revival about to be birthed, and that he saw darkness on the edge of the horizon.
mentions.quote: pains are going to accelerate as we step into September
mentions.falsify_match: A visible acceleration and a revival beginning in September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He counts that the Torres lawsuit was removed on 7 August, so 7 September will be one month, and notes that is the day of the eclipse.
mentions.quote: It'll be a month on the 7th on the day of the eclipse
mentions.falsify_match: Something of note on 7 September 2025, which is a real lunar eclipse date.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what happens after the revival is over when the shmita cycle ends in 2028, and repeats the three year window question of whether they will bring in the lost and help him.
mentions.quote: What will you do with this three-year window that I'm giving you?
mentions.condition_text: the outcome depends on whether they use the window
mentions.falsify_match: A harvest inside the window followed by its close in 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, absorbed by the what-will-you-do clause.

mentions.claim_text: He states plainly there is no such thing as aliens, only fallen angels and demonic spirits, and says he warned that right before Christ comes the Lord would show this.
mentions.quote: There is no such thing as aliens, but there is fallen angels
mentions.falsify_match: A disclosure event framed as extraterrestrial that he would read as fallen angels.
mentions.falsify_miss: No disclosure, though the reading is unfalsifiable either way.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is being prepared for a major event about to take place, signs of the times, and repeats his warnings about the poles shifting and the earth going to rock and reel like a drunkard.
mentions.quote: the earth is going to rock and reel like a d
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable change in the earth's rotation or magnetic poles.
